name: Primitive swatches into a labelled component outline
looks: A grid of eight flat colour cards at different tints and heights pops in on a stagger. It cuts to a small cluster of pill-shaped UI rows, boxed by a dashed outline with a small class-name label naming the pattern that arranges them.
build: The swatch grid reuses variant-stack-reveal's panel offsets (seeded x/y/scale, 10-30% uneven stagger) for the colour cards. The dashed box and label reuse annotated-diagram-overlay's leader-and-label mechanic, anchored to the cluster's bounding box.
sound: A soft cluster of hits as the swatches land, one tick on the dashed outline's draw-on.
prompt: Show a set of raw design primitives as a staggered grid of flat colour cards, then cut to a small real component built from the same system, boxed by a dashed outline and labelled with the one class name that produces it.
